{{Top|leg}}
The [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]], used [[Hieroglyphics|primitive '''hieroglyphs''']] to write [[Dressellese|their language]], until they traded them in favor of the [[Botha]]n alphabet. Contrarily to the influence of [[Bothese]] on the more romantic Dressellian language, the abandoning of those hieroglyphs was regarded as a positive change by many art critics.<ref name="Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>
